# Context Pack: `cli-dispatch-exit-contract` — CLI dispatch and exit-code envelope contract Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen). Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5. Domain: operator-interfaces. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments. ## 1. Purpose `cmd/ultraplan/main.go:18-43` wires OS argv/stdout/stderr, a signal context (`signal.NotifyContext` on SIGINT/SIGTERM, main.go:19), and the TUI/web runner adapters into `app.Run`, then exits with its integer return (`os.Exit`). `app.Run` (internal/app/app.go:88-178) is the single admission point for every invocation: it normalizes nil streams to `io.Discard` (stdout/stderr) or `os.Stdin` (stdin), defaults version and workdir, constructs the process-wide `runControlState` closed via defer (app.go:108-109), parses global flags, and dispatches one of 15 arms — `--help/-h`, `version`, and 13 command words (`init-workspace`, `defaults`, `skills`, `config`, `health`, `storage`, `run`, `project`, `sprint`, `study`, `tui`, `serve`, `code`) — at app.go:144-177; anything else is ExitUsage. The surface owns the numeric exit-class vocabulary (0-8, app.go:15-25), the stable-code strings derived from classes (`errorCode`, app.go:67-86), the classified-error wrapper that carries both a display string and an exit class (`classedError`, app.go:41-65), the stderr one-liner printer (`fail`, app.go:229-241), the shared JSON envelope writer (`json_output.go`), and the per-command renderers/flag grammars in `*_commands.go`. Scripts and agents consume three things: process exit codes, stdout bytes, and stderr bytes; docs/cli-reference.md declares those contracts. ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow ### 2.1 Global admission `parseGlobalFlags` (app.go:198-220) extracts only `--workspace ` / `--workspace=` (rejecting missing or dash-prefixed values) and passes all other tokens through in order; no other global flags exist. Empty argv, `--help`, `-h` print `renderHelp()` to stdout and exit 0 (app.go:140-146); unknown first token exits 2 with a pointer to `--help` (app.go:175-176). Every handler returns a single `error`; `failOrOK`/`fail` (app.go:222-241) print `err.Error()` as one stderr line and return the wrapped `classedError.class`, falling back to ExitError(1) for unclassed errors (including raw I/O write errors returned by handlers). `writeStatus` (app.go:243-248) returns ExitError if the stdout write itself fails. ### 2.2 Verb families - **Pure text inspectors** (no workspace mutation): `version` (app.go:147-148 → `renderVersion`), `config show [--json]` (config_commands.go:10-119; ~60 fixed `key: value` lines plus `(source: …)` provenance annotations; redaction applied before rendering), `project list|

status|

validate` (project_commands.go:10-75; validate findings are printed to **stderr**, project_commands.go:118-129, and any findings force ExitValidation). - **Workspace writers**: `init-workspace [--path --dry-run]` (workspace_commands.go), `defaults install [--path --dry-run --force]` (defaults_commands.go), `skills materialise [stage] [--path --dry-run --force]` accepting the `materialize` alias (skills_commands.go:17-23). All three print operation plans (`created/would create/overwrite/skip file …`) and use ExitWorkspace for failures. - **Durable-store door**: `run list|show|follow|cancel|diagnostics` (run_commands.go:19-40) — full behavior is the run-cli-observation pack's subject; this surface owns its arg parsing conventions (`std flag.FlagSet` with output discarded, `helpRequested` pre-check, `orderRunArgs` hand-rolled flag/positional reordering for show/follow/cancel/diagnostics, run_commands.go:463-481) and its error→class mapping `mapRunControlError` (403-414): ErrInvalidArgument→2, ErrNotFound→5, ErrConflict/ErrTerminal→8, everything else→6. - **Study/sprint product verbs** (§2.3-2.4): large hand-rolled positional+flag grammars over `study.Service` / `sprint.Service`. - **Frontends**: `tui` (tui_commands.go:21-61) and `serve` (serve_commands.go:18-99) build `dashboardUseCases`/`NewWebUseCases`, open the run-control repository, and delegate to injected runners; `serve` validates `--listen` as a numeric loopback IP:port *before* workspace discovery (ValidateLoopbackListen, serve_commands.go:119-139; test-enforced ordering serve_commands_test.go:51) and maps shutdown-time context cancellation to exit 0 (serve_commands.go:62-64, 92-97). - **Utility**: `storage migrate [--dry-run] [--json]` (storage_commands.go:33-140) imports study/sprint state files into SQLite and exits ExitPartial when any item failed (136-138); `code ... [--json] [--output]` (code_commands.go:19-78) maps extraction status Validation→5 / Partial→8. ### 2.3 Sprint verb grammar (sprint_commands.go) `runSprint` (28-566) requires ` `; `conformance-review` is aliased to `review` in-place (77-79). Help checks are position-sensitive (args[3]/args[4]). Per verb: - `status [--json]` (90-121): renders status; smoke-readiness failure categories `catalog`/`review_gate` downgrade the JSON `status` label to `"partial"` but still exit 0. - `metrics [--json]` (122-141): bare service DTO encoded directly (no envelope fields beyond the struct). - `validate ` (142-179): ten stages incl. execute/review/smoke; invalid stage → usage; failed validation → ExitValidation after printing findings. - `prompt [--explain]` (180-222): prints the rendered prompt verbatim to stdout; `--explain` emits explanation JSON instead. - `flow --to […]` (223-279): requires `--yes` for non-dry-run smoke targets (234-235); non-dry-run wraps work in `beginDurableCLICommand`; error classification ladder at 256-273: findings present → ExitValidation regardless of cause; else **`strings.Contains(err.Error(), "runtime")` → ExitRuntime** (269-272); else `mapSprintError`. - `verify […]` (280-328): same durable wrap; typed smoke errors go through `mapSmokeError`, others `mapSprintError`; assessment fail/blocked forces ExitValidation (325-327). The verify payload is emitted even on failure, with `status` taken from `result.Verification.Assessment` and an added `error` object from `stableCommandError` (313-318). - `execute […]` (329-368): durable wrap skipped for dry-run and for `--defer` (defer runs outside the durable boundary, 349-350); classification ladder 356-366: findings → 5; **`Contains(err.Error(), "failed tasks")` → ExitPartial**; **`Contains(err.Error(), "runtime")` → ExitRuntime**; else mapSprintError. - `qa [map|status|recover|cancel|run|resume]` (369-466): parser enforces flag/action compatibility (588-640, e.g., cancel requires `--run`, forbids `--shard`); run/resume take the durable path with QA writer-token handoff; progress callbacks print `[qa] …` to **stderr** with redacted messages (435-441); the JSON envelope `{schema_version, operation:"sprint.qa", status, result, error?}` is written to **stdout even on failure** (454-459), with `error` built by `stableQACommandError` (category, retryable, correlation_id, recovery, timestamp). - `review […]` (467-512): durable wrap unless dry-run; verdict fail or status blocked → ExitValidation; **`Contains(err.Error(), "runtime")` → ExitRuntime** (507-509); else mapSprintError. - `smoke […]` (513-562): `--yes` mandatory for non-dry-run (518-520); typed `mapSmokeError` decides everything (879-892): category cancellation→7, process/timeout/cleanup→6, all other typed categories→5; untyped falls back to mapSprintError; verdict fail/blocked → ExitValidation. Shared mappers: `mapSprintError` (944-963) orders `context.Canceled`→7, `DeadlineExceeded`→6, `ErrVerificationConflict`→8, flow-state and execute-state sentinels→5, project/sprint RefError→5, default→ExitWorkspace(4). `mapQACommandError` (662-679) maps canceled/deadline→**ExitPartial(8)** with codes `qa.cancelled`/`qa.deadline_exceeded`, QA-typed runtime/persistence→6 with codes `qa.`, other QA categories→5, fallback→mapSprintError. `stableCommandError` (1463-1470) reduces any classed error to `{code, message, recovery}` where message passes through `displaySafe` (usecases.go:251-278: config redaction + ANSI/control-char stripping). ### 2.4 Study verb grammar (study_commands.go, study_runs_commands.go) `runStudy` (26-120) routes `init | list | list | {summary, validate, status, runs, run-loop, run-all, run, synthesize, prompt}`; sub-verbs are matched positionally (`args[1]=="run-loop"` etc.). Runtime-backed verbs (`run-loop`, `run-all`, `run`, `synthesize`) wrap execution in `beginDurableCLICommand` and classify results afterwards: `classifyRunAllResult` (732-745) completed→0, cancelled→7, partial→8, runtime-failed→6, otherwise→5; `classifyExecutionResult` (933-948) completed/skipped→0, runtime-failed→6, cancelled→7, validation-failed/preflight-blocked→5, unknown status→ExitError(1). Read-only doors: `status [--json]` uses the shared envelope with `statusJSONResult` (status_json.go:67-145 — counts, redacted lock command, per-task usage/cost as `{known,value}` pairs, workspace-relative paths); `validate [--json]` uses the shared envelope with redacted checks and returns ExitValidation when failed (1012-1044); `summary`/`runs summary` regenerate artifacts and return 0 unless resolution/history sync fails. Error mappers: `mapStudyError`/`mapStudyPromptError`/`mapStudySummaryError` (RefError/config sentinels→5, default→4), `mapStudyRunLoopError` (locked→8, malformed/unsupported→5, else execution mapper), `mapStudyStatusError` (1162-1178 — missing/malformed→5, else→4, with a `displayError` wrapper whose display string has absolute paths rewritten relative via `strings.ReplaceAll`). ### 2.5 Durable acceptance coverage (dispatch-level contract) `beginDurableCLICommand` (durable_operations.go:49-60) opens the repository, accepts an outer operation row with an **empty alias digest** (so alias dedup is unreachable from CLI, durable_operations.go:55), claims it, appends a lifecycle-running event, and hands back a cancellation-aware context. CLI call sites: sprint flow/verify/execute/review/smoke/qa-run/qa-resume (6 textual call sites) and study run-loop/run-all/run/synthesize (4). Dry-run, prompt, validate, status, metrics, qa map/status/recover/cancel, storage, run-observation, and all foundation verbs skip acceptance. `finishDurableCLICommand` (86-91) joins the run error with `Finish`, which classifies the terminal outcome (ctx-done→cancelled, deadline→timed_out, err→failed, else succeeded) under a fresh 30 s `context.Background()` window so terminal persistence survives parent cancellation, and surfaces finish failure as a classed ExitRuntime error joined into the result. `TestEveryRuntimeBackedCLIEntryUsesDurableAcceptanceInventory` (run_control_inventory_test.go:11-55) pins these call-site counts and kind strings by reading the source files. ## 3. Inputs / outputs Inputs: `os.Args[1:]`; env vars read via `envLookup` (`ULTRAPLAN_WORKSPACE`, `ULTRAPLAN_STUDY_MODEL` studyModelOverride study_commands.go:183-188, QA/smoke settings via effective config, smoke `Getenv` injection sprint_commands.go:814-823); stdin for the three confirmation prompts (§5); filesystem state behind discovery/validation; wall clock (`timeNow` var, study_commands.go:1160, used in envelope timestamps and status reconciliation). Outputs, by stream: - **stdout**: help/version text; all human result renderers; all JSON envelopes and NDJSON (`run follow --json`); interactive prompts and their echoes for defaults/skills/run-loop-reset confirmations; `[run-loop]` task-progress lines (the documented exception to stderr-progress discipline, cli-reference.md:32); `serve` startup messages. - **stderr**: exactly one line per failed command via `fail()`; sanitized progress streams for sprint flow/verify/execute/review/smoke/qa and study run-all/run/synthesize (`[sprint]`, `[runtime]`, `[smoke]`, `[qa]` prefixes; redacted via `config.RedactValue`); project-validate findings; non-completed-task and warning summaries after study runs; serve diagnostics. - **exit code**: one of {0..8}; ExitError(1) is reachable only through write failures, unclassified handler errors, `serve`/`tui` runner failures, code-render failures, and the unknown-status arm of `classifyExecutionResult`. Envelope families (all schema_version 1): 1. Shared `writeJSON` envelope `{schema_version, command, workspace, status, generated_at, result}` (json_output.go:20-31): `config show`, `health`, `study validate`, `study status`, `run list/show/diagnostics` (diagnostics sets `status` to `string(health.Status)` rather than constant "ok"). 2. Ad-hoc command envelopes `{schema_version, operation, status, result, error?}` encoded inline: `sprint status/flow/verify/qa/review/smoke` (and `metrics` emits the bare DTO without wrapper fields). 3. Deterministic domain JSON: `code --json` (`codeextract.RenderJSON`), `storage migrate --json` (`storageMigrationResult` struct). Failure-path emission varies: health writes its envelope with status "fail" before returning the error (health_commands.go:46-50); sprint flow/verify/qa write failure envelopes best-effort (`_ =` discard of encode errors, e.g., sprint_commands.go:259, 318, 459); most other verbs emit nothing on stdout when failing. ## 4. Authoritative state None durable is owned here. This surface is projection/admission only: it creates no tables, holds no locks beyond what delegated layers acquire, and persists nothing except through delegated effects (files written by init/defaults/skills/study-init/code-output/prompt-output/storage-migrate; rows written via beginDurableCLICommand and runRepository; listener socket in serve). Process-local state: `runControlState` singleton (per-workspace repository+logger, closed at Run exit), the `durableOperationManager` created per accepted command (owned-operation map, control goroutine), and the injectable `timeNow`. The authoritative stores it touches belong to other surfaces: `.ultraplan/run-control.db` (run-journal-fencing), flow-state/execute-state/QA files (sprint-flow-state, sprint-qa-investigation), run-state.json (study-runloop-scheduler), product-state DB (product-state-mirror). ## 5. Invariants (as implemented) - One admission function; every exit path flows through `fail`/`writeStatus` so each command produces at most one stderr line and a single class from {0..8}. - Classified errors preserve their cause chain (`Unwrap`, app.go:48) so `errors.Is/As` ladders operate on original sentinels/typed errors while the class rides on the wrapper. - Stable code strings per class (`errorCode`); QA adds a finer `qa.` code vocabulary carried inside JSON payloads (phase3-json-schemas.md:35 closed list). - Interactive confirmations have no TTY detection anywhere: `confirmOverwriteDefaults` (defaults_commands.go:125-144), `confirmOverwriteSkills` (skills_commands.go:148-167), and `confirmRunLoopReplacement` (study_commands.go:277-316) read one line from configured stdin; EOF is tolerated (treated as a non-affirmative answer); non-"yes/y" answers keep existing files or refuse replacement (replacement refusal exits ExitPartial "replacement not confirmed", study_commands.go:314). Destructive non-interactive paths require explicit flags instead: `--force` (defaults/skills), `--reset --yes` (run-loop), `--yes` (smoke/flow-to-smoke/verify-to-smoke), `--force-review --override-reason` pairs enforced at parse time (sprint_commands.go:873-876, 1070-1072, 1187-1189). - Stream discipline as documented: runtime-backed sprint progress → stderr; final results → stdout; study run-loop progress → stdout by documented exception; human errors → stderr. - Durable acceptance precedes runtime work for exactly the inventory-pinned entry set; acceptance happens after parse/discover/config so malformed invocations never create runs. - Terminal proposal after cancellation uses a detached context, so a cancelled command still records its durable outcome when persistence is reachable. - Redaction before display on every renderer that embeds potentially sensitive values (`config.RedactValue` calls across config/health/study/sprint/QA renderers); `displaySafe` additionally strips ANSI escapes/control bytes for JSON-embedded messages. ## 6. Trust boundaries - All argv tokens, env vars, and stdin answers are untrusted admission input. They reach: workspace/config loading (validated downstream by config-inspection-health), file paths for init/defaults/skills/code-output/prompt-output (`--output` for study prompt is containment-checked via `workspace.ResolveInside`, study_commands.go:1409; `code --output` is not contained, only made absolute against workDir, code_commands.go:56-65), model refs (`--model`, passed through to runtime request construction), listen address (strictly validated loopback-only), and identifiers echoed into error strings (e.g., `%q` of unknown commands/stages). - Error text is inspected by classifiers: the sprint flow/execute/review ladders branch on substrings of `err.Error()` ("runtime", "failed tasks") produced by lower packages; everything else classifies via typed sentinel/`errors.As` matches. A parallel guard exists for the TUI/web operation path asserting free-form text does not affect classification there (sprint_error_test.go:29-41); the CLI substring branches are separate code. - Error text also reaches consumers: `fail()` prints `err.Error()` verbatim to stderr (causes are app-constructed; several embed user-supplied tokens quoted); JSON envelopes embed only `displaySafe`-processed messages; `stableCommandError`'s fixed `recovery` string is constant. - Confirmation prompts accept any stdin bytes; only exact `yes`/`y` (case-insensitive, trimmed) affirm. - The `serve` door inherits web-security-boundary controls; dispatch contributes the loopback-listen validation and never forwards raw argv further. ## 7. External effects & lifecycle semantics External effects per invocation can include: workspace scaffold/default/skill file creation or overwrite (with confirm/force gates); git clone subprocesses during `study init` (partial failures → ExitPartial with redacted clone output, study_init_commands_test.go:113); SQLite DB/schema creation (`storage migrate` non-dry-run opens runcontrol + productstate); durable run rows/events/terminals in run-control.db for accepted verbs; report/prompt/output file writes; a listening loopback socket and optional platform browser launch (`openBrowser`, main.go:45-62, exec of `open`/`rundll32`/`xdg-open` with 5 s timeout); TUI takeover of stdout. Cancellation semantics: the process-level context derives from SIGINT/SIGTERM. For durable-wrapped verbs, cancellation propagates through the accepted operation's child context; `Finish` records cancelled/timed_out terminals; `mapSprintError` yields exit 7 for plain cancellation while the QA command path deliberately yields exit 8 with code `qa.cancelled` (both behaviors test-pinned). `serve` treats shutdown cancellation as success (exit 0) after drain. `run follow` ends observation-only on ctx-done (exit 0). Non-durable verbs simply unwind; partial side effects (e.g., half-written scaffolds) are not compensated anywhere in this layer. Retry semantics: none at this layer — no handler retries on failure; retryability is expressed only as data (`retryable` booleans in QA error payloads; typed store-error flags consumed elsewhere). Restart semantics: stateless between invocations; every invocation re-runs discovery/config and (for repository-opening verbs) startup reconcile owned by deeper surfaces. Error semantics summary matrix (reachable classes per family): - Foundation/help/version: 0, 1 (write failure), 2 (usage), 3 (config), 4 (workspace). - health: 0, 2, 3 (config wins precedence), 4 (discovery), 5 (structure), 6 (runtime checks) — precedence order cfgErr → runtimeFailed → structure validation (health_commands.go:100-108). - code: 0, 1, 2, 4 (extract/output), 5 (validation status), 8 (unresolved references). - run *: 0, 2, 5, 6, 8 via mapRunControlError. - project: 0, 2, 4, 5. - sprint: 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 via the ladders above. - study: 0, 1 (unknown status), 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 via the classifiers above. - storage: 0, 2, 4, 8. - tui/serve: 0, 1 (runner failure), 2, 3, 4, 6. ## 8. Immediate surface dependencies - **config-inspection-health** (foundation): supplies `discoverWorkspace`/`loadEffectiveConfig` (app.go:287-319), the redaction used by every renderer, `EnvOverrides` listing for the health environment summary, and the config-error exit class; health additionally consumes runtime health checks (`runtimeHealthChecks` var seam, health_commands.go:28). - **durable-operation-spine** (durability-core): `beginDurableCLICommand`, `finishDurableCLICommand`, `controlledRuntimeFor`, `runRepository`, QA writer-token mint/fence — the acceptance spine this surface calls into for its 10 pinned call sites. - **run-cli-observation**: implements the `run` arm under the dispatch/exit/envelope conventions defined here (its `mapRunControlError` and envelope choices are part of the same operator contract). - **shared-usecase-vocabulary**: defines the OperationKind enum and request shapes the CLI passes into acceptance; the empty-CLI-digest regime originates at durable_operations.go:55. - **workspace-scaffold-defaults**: backs init-workspace/defaults/skills plan/install functions whose outputs this surface renders. - Sibling frontends (web-routing-projection, web-operation-hub-sse, tui-console, web-security-boundary) reuse the same use cases; parity expectations live in shared-usecase-vocabulary, not here. - Foundation libraries: workspace.Discover/Rel/ResolveInside/Init/PlanDefaults/MaterialiseSkills, project/sprint/study services, codeextract, runcontrol, productstate. ## 9. The surface owns the numeric exit-class vocabulary (0-8, app.go:15-25), the stable-code strings derived from classes (`errorCode`, app.go:67-86), the classified-error wrapper that carries both a display string and an exit class (`classedError`, app.go:41-65), the stderr one-liner printer (`fail`, app.go:229-241), the shared JSON envelope writer (`json_output.go`), and the per-command renderers/flag grammars in `*_commands.go`. Scripts and agents consume three things: process exit codes, stdout bytes, and stderr bytes; docs/cli-reference.md declares those contracts. ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow ### 2.1 Global admission `parseGlobalFlags` (app.go:198-220) extracts only `--workspace ` / `--workspace=` (rejecting missing or dash-prefixed values) and passes all other tokens through in order; no other global flags exist. Empty argv, `--help`, `-h` print `renderHelp()` to stdout and exit 0 (app.go:140-146); unknown first token exits 2 with a pointer to `--help` (app.go:175-176). Every handler returns a single `error`; `failOrOK`/`fail` (app.go:222-241) print `err.Error()` as one stderr line and return the wrapped `classedError.class`, falling back to ExitError(1) for unclassed errors (including raw I/O write errors returned by handlers). `writeStatus` (app.go:243-248) returns ExitError if the stdout write itself fails. ### 2.2 Verb families - **Pure text inspectors** (no workspace mutation): `version` (app.go:147-148 → `renderVersion`), `config show [--json]` (config_commands.go:10-119; ~60 fixed `key: value` lines plus `(source: …)` provenance annotations; redaction applied before rendering), `project list|

status|

validate` (project_commands.go:10-75; validate findings are printed to **stderr**, project_commands.go:118-129, and any findings force ExitValidation). - **Workspace writers**: `init-workspace [--path --dry-run]` (workspace_commands.go), `defaults install [--path --dry-run --force]` (defaults_commands.go), `skills materialise [stage] [--path --dry-run --force]` accepting the `materialize` alias (skills_commands.go:17-23). All three print operation plans (`created/would create/overwrite/skip file …`) and use ExitWorkspace for failures. - **Durable-store door**: `run list|show|follow|cancel|diagnostics` (run_commands.go:19-40) — full behavior is the run-cli-observation pack's subject; this surface owns its arg parsing conventions (`std flag.FlagSet` with output discarded, `helpRequested` pre-check, `orderRunArgs` hand-rolled flag/positional reordering for show/follow/cancel/diagnostics, run_commands.go:463-481) and its error→class mapping `mapRunControlError` (403-414): ErrInvalidArgument→2, ErrNotFound→5, ErrConflict/ErrTerminal→8, everything else→6. - **Study/sprint product verbs** (§2.3-2.4): large hand-rolled positional+flag grammars over `study.Service` / `sprint.Service`.

376: 		if parseErr != nil {
377: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.qa: %w", parseErr)
378: 		}
379: 		operationStatus := "ok"
380: 		var qaResult QAResult
381: 		var runErr error
382: 		switch qaCommand.Action {
383: 		case "map":
384: 			mapped, mapErr := qaService.QAMap(args[0], args[1])
385: 			runErr = mapErr
386: 			if mapErr == nil {
387: 				qaResult = qaMapProjection(mapped.Map)
388: 			}
389: 		case "status":
390: 			snapshot, statusErr := qaService.QAStatus(args[0], args[1])
391: 			runErr = statusErr
392: 			if statusErr == nil {
393: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
394: 			}
395: 		case "recover":
396: 			snapshot, recoverErr := qaService.RecoverQA(deps.ctx, args[0], args[1])
397: 			runErr = recoverErr
398: 			if recoverErr == nil {
399: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
400: 			}
401: 		case "cancel":
402: 			repository, _, repositoryErr := runRepository(deps)
403: 			if repositoryErr != nil {
404: 				runErr = repositoryErr
405: 				break
406: 			}
407: 			useCases := dashboardUseCases{root: root.Path, qaSettings: qa, runs: repositoryRunUseCases{repository: repository}}
408: 			cancelled, cancelErr := useCases.CancelQA(deps.ctx, QARequest{Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], RunID: qaCommand.RunID})
409: 			runErr = cancelErr
410: 			qaResult = cancelled.QA
411: 			if cancelErr == nil {
412: 				qaResult.NextAction = fmt.Sprintf("cancellation requested=%t run=%s; %s", cancelled.Requested, cancelled.Run.RunID, qaResult.NextAction)
413: 			}
414: 		case "run", "resume":
415: 			kind := OperationQAStart
416: 			if qaCommand.Action == "resume" {
417: 				kind = OperationQAResume
418: 			}
419: 			durable, durableErr := beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: kind, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Task: qaCommand.Shard})
420: 			if durableErr != nil {
421: 				runErr = durableErr
422: 				break
423: 			}
424: 			token, fence, ownershipErr := durable.QAWriterToken()
425: 			if ownershipErr != nil {
426: 				runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, ownershipErr)
427: 				break
428: 			}
429: 			runtimeService, serviceErr := sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
430: 			if serviceErr != nil {
431: 				runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, serviceErr)
432: 				break
433: 			}
434: 			runtimeService = runtimeService.WithQAWriterFence(fence)
435: 			_, qaErr := runtimeService.RunQA(durable.Context(), args[0], args[1], sprint.QARunRequest{Resume: qaCommand.Action == "resume", FocusShard: qaCommand.Shard, WriterToken: token, Progress: func(progress sprint.QAProgress) {
436: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[qa] %s %d/%d", progress.Phase, progress.Completed, progress.Total)
437: 				if progress.ShardID != "" {
438: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %s", progress.ShardID)
439: 				}
440: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, ": %s\n", config.RedactValue("qa.progress", progress.Message))
441: 			}})
442: 			runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, qaErr)
443: 			snapshot, statusErr := runtimeService.QAStatus(args[0], args[1])
444: 			if statusErr == nil {
445: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
446: 			} else {
447: 				runErr = errors.Join(runErr, statusErr)
448: 			}
449: 		}
450: 		if runErr != nil {
451: 			operationStatus = "failed"
452: 		}
453: 		qaResult = (dashboardUseCases{root: root.Path, qaSettings: qa, readOnly: true}).withQAConformanceReview(QARequest{Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1]}, qaResult)
454: 		if qaCommand.JSON {
455: 			payload := map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.qa", "status": operationStatus, "result": qaResult}
456: 			if runErr != nil {
457: 				payload["error"] = stableQACommandError(mapQACommandError(runErr), runErr, qaResult)
458: 			}
459: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(payload)
460: 		} else {
461: 			renderSprintQA(deps, qaResult)
462: 		}
463: 		if runErr != nil {
464: 			return mapQACommandError(runErr)
465: 		}
466: 		return nil
467: 	case "review":
468: 		req, jsonOut, err := parseSprintReviewArgs(args[3:])
469: 		if err != nil {
470: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.review: %w", err)
471: 		}
472: 		reviewService := service
473: 		runCtx := deps.ctx
474: 		var durable *durableCLICommand
475: 		if !req.DryRun {
476: 			req.Progress = func(progress sprint.ReviewProgress) {
477: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[sprint] Conformance Review coverage %d/%d", progress.Completed, progress.Total)
478: 				if progress.CoverageID != "" {
479: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %s", progress.CoverageID)
480: 				}
481: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, ": %s\n", progress.Message)
482: 			}
483: 			durable, err = beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationReviewStart, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Stage: "review", RestartReview: req.Restart})
484: 			if err != nil {
485: 				return err
486: 			}
487: 			runCtx = durable.Context()
488: 			reviewService, err = sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
489: 			if err != nil {
490: 				return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
491: 			}
492: 		}
493: 		result, runErr := reviewService.Review(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
494: 		runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, runErr)
495: 		if jsonOut {
496: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.review", "status": result.Status, "result": result})
497: 		} else {
498: 			renderSprintReview(deps, result)
499: 		}
500: 		if runErr != nil {
501: 			if result.Verdict == sprint.ReviewFail {
502: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
503: 			}
504: 			if result.Status == sprint.ReviewBlocked {
505: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
506: 			}
507: 			if strings.Contains(runErr.Error(), "runtime") {
508: 				return classified(ExitRuntime, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
509: 			}
510: 			return mapSprintError("sprint.review", runErr)
511: 		}
512: 		return nil
513: 	case "smoke":
514: 		req, jsonOut, err := parseSprintSmokeArgs(args[3:])
515: 		if err != nil {
516: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.smoke: %w", err)
517: 		}
518: 		if !req.DryRun && !req.NonInteractive {
519: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.smoke: --yes is required for non-interactive external harness execution")
520: 		}
521: 		if !req.DryRun {
522: 			req.Progress = func(progress sprint.SmokeProgress) {
523: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[smoke] %-20s", progress.Phase)
524: 				if progress.Test != "" {
525: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " test=%s", progress.Test)
526: 				} else if progress.Suite != "" {
527: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " suite=%s", progress.Suite)
528: 				}
529: 				if progress.Total > 0 {
530: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %d/%d", progress.Completed, progress.Total)
531: 				}
532: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " | %s\n", config.RedactValue("smoke.progress", progress.Message))
533: 			}
534: 		}
535: 		smokeService := service
536: 		runCtx := deps.ctx
537: 		var durable *durableCLICommand
538: 		if !req.DryRun {
539: 			durable, err = beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationSmokeStart, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Stage: "smoke", Level: string(req.Level), Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test})
540: 			if err != nil {
541: 				return err
542: 			}
543: 			runCtx = durable.Context()
544: 			smokeService, err = sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
545: 			if err != nil {
546: 				return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
547: 			}
548: 		}
549: 		result, runErr := smokeService.RunSmoke(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
550: 		runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, runErr)
551: 		if jsonOut {
552: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.smoke", "status": result.Status, "result": result})
553: 		} else {
554: 			renderSprintSmoke(deps, result)
555: 		}
556: 		if runErr != nil {
557: 			return mapSmokeError(runErr)
558: 		}
559: 		if result.Verdict == sprint.SmokeFailVerdict || result.Verdict == sprint.SmokeBlockedVerdict {
560: 			return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.smoke: verdict %s; %s", result.Verdict, result.NextAction)
561: 		}
562: 		return nil
563: 	default:
564: 		return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint: unsupported command %q", args[2])
565: 	}
566: }

568: func stripFlag(args []string, flag string) ([]string, bool) {
569: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(args))
570: 	found := false

588: func parseSprintQAArgs(args []string) (sprintQACommand, error) {
589: 	command := sprintQACommand{Action: "run"}
590: 	if len(args) > 0 {
591: 		switch args[0] {
592: 		case "status", "resume", "cancel", "recover":
593: 			command.Action = args[0]
594: 			args = args[1:]
595: 		}
596: 	}
597: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
598: 		switch args[i] {
599: 		case "--dry-run":
600: 			if command.Action != "run" {
601: 				return command, fmt.Errorf("--dry-run cannot be combined with %s", command.Action)
602: 			}
603: 			command.Action = "map"
604: 		case "--json":
605: 			command.JSON = true
606: 		case "--shard":
607: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
608: 				return command, errors.New("--shard requires a map-owned shard ID")
609: 			}
610: 			command.Shard = args[i+1]
611: 			i++
612: 		case "--run":
613: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
614: 				return command, errors.New("--run requires a durable run ID")
615: 			}
616: 			command.RunID = args[i+1]
617: 			i++
618: 		default:
619: 			return command, fmt.Errorf("unknown QA argument %q", args[i])
620: 		}
621: 	}
622: 	switch command.Action {
623: 	case "run", "resume":
624: 		if command.RunID != "" {
625: 			return command, errors.New("--run is valid only with qa cancel")
626: 		}
627: 	case "cancel":
628: 		if command.RunID == "" {
629: 			return command, errors.New("qa cancel requires --run")
630: 		}
631: 		if command.Shard != "" {
632: 			return command, errors.New("qa cancel does not accept --shard")
633: 		}
634: 	case "map", "status", "recover":
635: 		if command.Shard != "" || command.RunID != "" {
636: 			return command, fmt.Errorf("qa %s does not accept --shard or --run", command.Action)
637: 		}
638: 	}
639: 	return command, nil
640: }

642: func renderSprintQA(deps dependencies, result QAResult) {
643: 	if result.Phase == string(sprint.QAPhaseCompleted) {
644: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Read-only QA completed")
645: 	} else {
646: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Read-only QA")
647: 	}
648: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  sprint: %s/%s\n  phase: %s\n  fresh: %t\n", result.Project, result.Sprint, result.Phase, result.Fresh)
649: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  Conformance Review: status=%s verdict=%s fresh=%t\n", result.ConformanceReviewStatus, result.ConformanceReviewVerdict, result.ConformanceReviewFresh)
650: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  coverage: %d/%d changed paths\n  shards: %d/%d\n", result.CoveredPaths, result.ChangedPaths, result.CompletedShards, result.TotalShards)
651: 	for _, outcome := range []string{"confirmed", "refuted", "invalid", "inconclusive", "blocked", "cross_shard", "not_applicable"} {
652: 		if count := result.OutcomeTotals[outcome]; count > 0 {
653: 			fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  theories.%s: %d\n", outcome, count)
654: 		}
655: 	}
656: 	if result.Blocker != nil {
657: 		fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  blocker: %s (%s)\n", result.Blocker.Summary, result.Blocker.Category)
658: 	}
659: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  next: %s\n", result.NextAction)
660: }

662: func mapQACommandError(err error) error {
663: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
664: 		code := "qa.cancelled"
665: 		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
666: 			code = "qa.deadline_exceeded"
667: 		}
668: 		return classedError{class: ExitPartial, code: code, err: fmt.Errorf("sprint.qa: %w", err)}
669: 	}
670: 	if typed, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
671: 		class := ExitValidation
672: 		switch typed.Category {
673: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
674: 			class = ExitRuntime
675: 		}
676: 		return classedError{class: class, code: "qa." + string(typed.Category), err: fmt.Errorf("sprint.qa: %w", err)}
677: 	}
678: 	return mapSprintError("sprint.qa", err)
679: }

713: func qaSettings(effective config.Effective) (sprint.QASettings, error) {
714: 	c := effective.Config.QA
715: 	model := strings.TrimSpace(c.Model)
716: 	modelSource := effective.Sources["qa.model"]
717: 	if model == "" {
718: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Planning.ReviewModel)
719: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["planning.review_model"]
720: 	}
721: 	if model == "" {
722: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Planning.PlanModel)
723: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["planning.plan_model"]
724: 	}
725: 	if model == "" {
726: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Models.Default)
727: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["models.default"]
728: 	}
729: 	variant := strings.TrimSpace(c.Variant)
730: 	variantSource := effective.Sources["qa.variant"]
731: 	if variant == "" {
732: 		variant = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Execution.DefaultVariant)
733: 		variantSource = effective.Sources["execution.default_variant"]
734: 	}
735: 	parseDuration := func(field, value string) (time.Duration, error) {
736: 		duration, parseErr := time.ParseDuration(value)
737: 		if parseErr != nil {
738: 			return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", field, parseErr)
739: 		}
740: 		return duration, nil
741: 	}
742: 	commandTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.command_timeout", c.CommandTimeout)
743: 	if err != nil {
744: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
745: 	}
746: 	shardTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.shard_timeout", c.ShardTimeout)
747: 	if err != nil {
748: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
749: 	}
750: 	runTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.run_timeout", c.RunTimeout)
751: 	if err != nil {
752: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
753: 	}
754: 	cleanupTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.cleanup_timeout", c.CleanupTimeout)
755: 	if err != nil {
756: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
757: 	}
758: 	sources := make([]sprint.QAEffectiveSource, 0, len(config.QAConfigFields()))
759: 	for _, field := range config.QAConfigFields() {
760: 		source := effective.Sources[field]
761: 		if field == "qa.model" {
762: 			source = modelSource
763: 		}
764: 		if field == "qa.variant" {
765: 			source = variantSource
766: 		}
767: 		sources = append(sources, sprint.QAEffectiveSource{Field: field, Source: source})
768: 	}
769: 	sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].Field < sources[j].Field })
770: 	settings := sprint.QASettings{Runtime: sprint.StageRuntime{Model: model, Variant: variant}, Sources: sources, Budgets: sprint.QABudgets{
771: 		ChangedPaths: c.ChangedPaths, PrimaryShards: c.PrimaryShards, BoundaryShards: c.BoundaryShards,
772: 		FollowUpShards: c.FollowUpShards, TotalShards: c.TotalShards, PendingEntries: c.PendingEntries,
773: 		ChangedPathsPerShard: c.ChangedPathsPerShard, ContextPathsPerShard: c.ContextPathsPerShard,
774: 		ContextExpansions: c.ContextExpansions, PathsPerExpansion: c.PathsPerExpansion,
775: 		BehavioralConcernsPerShard: c.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, TheoriesPerShard: c.TheoriesPerShard,
776: 		IterationsPerAttempt: c.IterationsPerAttempt, CommandsPerAttempt: c.CommandsPerAttempt,
777: 		RuntimeRetries: c.RuntimeRetries, ConcurrentInvestigators: c.ConcurrentInvestigators,
778: 		CommandTimeout: commandTimeout, ShardTimeout: shardTimeout, RunTimeout: runTimeout,
779: 		CleanupTimeout: cleanupTimeout, CommandOutputBytes: c.CommandOutputBytes,
780: 		ShardOutputBytes: c.ShardOutputBytes, PromptBytes: c.PromptBytes,
781: 		RecentProgress: c.RecentProgress, RetainedAttempts: c.RetainedAttempts, StateBytes: c.StateBytes,
782: 	}}
783: 	if err := sprint.ValidateQASettings(settings); err != nil {
784: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
785: 	}
786: 	return settings, nil
787: }

825: func parseSprintSmokeArgs(args []string) (sprint.SmokeRequest, bool, error) {
826: 	var req sprint.SmokeRequest
827: 	jsonOut := false
828: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
829: 		switch args[i] {
830: 		case "--level", "--suite", "--test", "--timeout", "--override-reason":
831: 			if i+1 >= len(args) {
832: 				return req, jsonOut, fmt.Errorf("%s requires a value", args[i])
833: 			}
834: 			key, value := args[i], args[i+1]
835: 			i++
836: 			switch key {
837: 			case "--level":
838: 				req.Level = value
839: 			case "--suite":
840: 				req.Suite = value
841: 			case "--test":
842: 				req.Test = value
843: 			case "--timeout":
844: 				d, err := time.ParseDuration(value)
845: 				if err != nil || d <= 0 || d > 24*time.Hour {

944: func mapSprintError(prefix string, err error) error {
945: 	var projectRef project.RefError
946: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
947: 	switch {
948: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
949: 		return classified(ExitCancel, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
950: 	case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
951: 		return classified(ExitRuntime, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
952: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict):
953: 		return classified(ExitPartial, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
954: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported):
955: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
956: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported):
957: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
958: 	case errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef):
959: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
960: 	default:
961: 		return classified(ExitWorkspace, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
962: 	}
963: }

979: func addSprintStageOverride(overrides map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime, flag, spec string) (map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime, error) {
980: 	stageName, value, found := strings.Cut(spec, "=")
981: 	stageName = strings.TrimSpace(stageName)
982: 	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
983: 	if !found || stageName == "" || value == "" {
984: 		return overrides, fmt.Errorf("%s requires <stage>=<value> (for example %sexecute=provider/model)", flag, flag)
985: 	}
986: 	stage, ok := sprintStageOverrideTargets[stageName]
987: 	if !ok {
988: 		return overrides, fmt.Errorf("%s: unsupported stage %q", flag, stageName)
989: 	}
990: 	if overrides == nil {
991: 		overrides = map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime{}
992: 	}
993: 	override := overrides[stage]
994: 	if flag == "--stage-model" {
995: 		override.Model = value
996: 	} else {
997: 		override.Variant = value
998: 	}
999: 	overrides[stage] = override
1000: 	return overrides, nil
1001: }

398: 			if recoverErr == nil {
399: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
400: 			}
401: 		case "cancel":
402: 			repository, _, repositoryErr := runRepository(deps)
403: 			if repositoryErr != nil {
404: 				runErr = repositoryErr
405: 				break
406: 			}
407: 			useCases := dashboardUseCases{root: root.Path, qaSettings: qa, runs: repositoryRunUseCases{repository: repository}}
408: 			cancelled, cancelErr := useCases.CancelQA(deps.ctx, QARequest{Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], RunID: qaCommand.RunID})
409: 			runErr = cancelErr
410: 			qaResult = cancelled.QA
411: 			if cancelErr == nil {
412: 				qaResult.NextAction = fmt.Sprintf("cancellation requested=%t run=%s; %s", cancelled.Requested, cancelled.Run.RunID, qaResult.NextAction)
413: 			}
414: 		case "run", "resume":
415: 			kind := OperationQAStart
416: 			if qaCommand.Action == "resume" {
417: 				kind = OperationQAResume
418: 			}
419: 			durable, durableErr := beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: kind, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Task: qaCommand.Shard})
420: 			if durableErr != nil {
421: 				runErr = durableErr
422: 				break
423: 			}
424: 			token, fence, ownershipErr := durable.QAWriterToken()
425: 			if ownershipErr != nil {
426: 				runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, ownershipErr)
427: 				break
428: 			}
429: 			runtimeService, serviceErr := sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
430: 			if serviceErr != nil {
431: 				runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, serviceErr)
432: 				break
433: 			}
434: 			runtimeService = runtimeService.WithQAWriterFence(fence)
435: 			_, qaErr := runtimeService.RunQA(durable.Context(), args[0], args[1], sprint.QARunRequest{Resume: qaCommand.Action == "resume", FocusShard: qaCommand.Shard, WriterToken: token, Progress: func(progress sprint.QAProgress) {
436: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[qa] %s %d/%d", progress.Phase, progress.Completed, progress.Total)
437: 				if progress.ShardID != "" {
438: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %s", progress.ShardID)
439: 				}
440: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, ": %s\n", config.RedactValue("qa.progress", progress.Message))
441: 			}})
442: 			runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, qaErr)
443: 			snapshot, statusErr := runtimeService.QAStatus(args[0], args[1])
444: 			if statusErr == nil {
445: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
446: 			} else {
447: 				runErr = errors.Join(runErr, statusErr)
448: 			}
449: 		}
450: 		if runErr != nil {
451: 			operationStatus = "failed"
452: 		}
453: 		qaResult = (dashboardUseCases{root: root.Path, qaSettings: qa, readOnly: true}).withQAConformanceReview(QARequest{Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1]}, qaResult)
454: 		if qaCommand.JSON {
455: 			payload := map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.qa", "status": operationStatus, "result": qaResult}
456: 			if runErr != nil {
457: 				payload["error"] = stableQACommandError(mapQACommandError(runErr), runErr, qaResult)
458: 			}
459: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(payload)
460: 		} else {
461: 			renderSprintQA(deps, qaResult)
462: 		}
463: 		if runErr != nil {
464: 			return mapQACommandError(runErr)
465: 		}
466: 		return nil
467: 	case "review":
468: 		req, jsonOut, err := parseSprintReviewArgs(args[3:])
469: 		if err != nil {
470: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.review: %w", err)
471: 		}
472: 		reviewService := service
473: 		runCtx := deps.ctx
474: 		var durable *durableCLICommand
475: 		if !req.DryRun {
476: 			req.Progress = func(progress sprint.ReviewProgress) {
477: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[sprint] Conformance Review coverage %d/%d", progress.Completed, progress.Total)
478: 				if progress.CoverageID != "" {
479: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %s", progress.CoverageID)
480: 				}
481: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, ": %s\n", progress.Message)
482: 			}
483: 			durable, err = beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationReviewStart, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Stage: "review", RestartReview: req.Restart})
484: 			if err != nil {
485: 				return err
486: 			}
487: 			runCtx = durable.Context()
488: 			reviewService, err = sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
489: 			if err != nil {
490: 				return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
491: 			}
492: 		}
493: 		result, runErr := reviewService.Review(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
494: 		runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, runErr)
495: 		if jsonOut {
496: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.review", "status": result.Status, "result": result})
497: 		} else {
498: 			renderSprintReview(deps, result)
499: 		}
500: 		if runErr != nil {
501: 			if result.Verdict == sprint.ReviewFail {
502: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
503: 			}
504: 			if result.Status == sprint.ReviewBlocked {
505: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
506: 			}
507: 			if strings.Contains(runErr.Error(), "runtime") {
508: 				return classified(ExitRuntime, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
509: 			}
510: 			return mapSprintError("sprint.review", runErr)
511: 		}
512: 		return nil
513: 	case "smoke":
514: 		req, jsonOut, err := parseSprintSmokeArgs(args[3:])
515: 		if err != nil {
516: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.smoke: %w", err)
517: 		}
518: 		if !req.DryRun && !req.NonInteractive {
519: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.smoke: --yes is required for non-interactive external harness execution")
520: 		}
521: 		if !req.DryRun {
522: 			req.Progress = func(progress sprint.SmokeProgress) {
523: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[smoke] %-20s", progress.Phase)
524: 				if progress.Test != "" {
525: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " test=%s", progress.Test)
526: 				} else if progress.Suite != "" {
527: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " suite=%s", progress.Suite)
528: 				}
529: 				if progress.Total > 0 {
530: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %d/%d", progress.Completed, progress.Total)
531: 				}
532: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " | %s\n", config.RedactValue("smoke.progress", progress.Message))
533: 			}
534: 		}
535: 		smokeService := service
536: 		runCtx := deps.ctx
537: 		var durable *durableCLICommand
538: 		if !req.DryRun {
539: 			durable, err = beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationSmokeStart, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Stage: "smoke", Level: string(req.Level), Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test})
540: 			if err != nil {
541: 				return err
542: 			}
543: 			runCtx = durable.Context()
544: 			smokeService, err = sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
545: 			if err != nil {
546: 				return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
547: 			}
548: 		}
549: 		result, runErr := smokeService.RunSmoke(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
550: 		runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, runErr)
551: 		if jsonOut {
552: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.smoke", "status": result.Status, "result": result})
553: 		} else {
554: 			renderSprintSmoke(deps, result)
555: 		}
556: 		if runErr != nil {
557: 			return mapSmokeError(runErr)
558: 		}
559: 		if result.Verdict == sprint.SmokeFailVerdict || result.Verdict == sprint.SmokeBlockedVerdict {
560: 			return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.smoke: verdict %s; %s", result.Verdict, result.NextAction)
561: 		}
562: 		return nil
563: 	default:
564: 		return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint: unsupported command %q", args[2])
565: 	}
566: }

568: func stripFlag(args []string, flag string) ([]string, bool) {
569: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(args))
570: 	found := false
571: 	for _, arg := range args {

588: func parseSprintQAArgs(args []string) (sprintQACommand, error) {
589: 	command := sprintQACommand{Action: "run"}
590: 	if len(args) > 0 {
591: 		switch args[0] {
592: 		case "status", "resume", "cancel", "recover":
593: 			command.Action = args[0]
594: 			args = args[1:]
595: 		}
596: 	}
597: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
598: 		switch args[i] {
599: 		case "--dry-run":
600: 			if command.Action != "run" {
601: 				return command, fmt.Errorf("--dry-run cannot be combined with %s", command.Action)
602: 			}
603: 			command.Action = "map"
604: 		case "--json":
605: 			command.JSON = true
606: 		case "--shard":
607: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
608: 				return command, errors.New("--shard requires a map-owned shard ID")
609: 			}
610: 			command.Shard = args[i+1]
611: 			i++
612: 		case "--run":
613: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
614: 				return command, errors.New("--run requires a durable run ID")
615: 			}
616: 			command.RunID = args[i+1]
617: 			i++
618: 		default:
619: 			return command, fmt.Errorf("unknown QA argument %q", args[i])
620: 		}
621: 	}
622: 	switch command.Action {
623: 	case "run", "resume":
624: 		if command.RunID != "" {
625: 			return command, errors.New("--run is valid only with qa cancel")
626: 		}
627: 	case "cancel":
628: 		if command.RunID == "" {
629: 			return command, errors.New("qa cancel requires --run")
630: 		}
631: 		if command.Shard != "" {
632: 			return command, errors.New("qa cancel does not accept --shard")
633: 		}
634: 	case "map", "status", "recover":
635: 		if command.Shard != "" || command.RunID != "" {
636: 			return command, fmt.Errorf("qa %s does not accept --shard or --run", command.Action)
637: 		}
638: 	}
639: 	return command, nil
640: }

642: func renderSprintQA(deps dependencies, result QAResult) {
643: 	if result.Phase == string(sprint.QAPhaseCompleted) {
644: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Read-only QA completed")
645: 	} else {
646: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Read-only QA")
647: 	}
648: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  sprint: %s/%s\n  phase: %s\n  fresh: %t\n", result.Project, result.Sprint, result.Phase, result.Fresh)
649: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  Conformance Review: status=%s verdict=%s fresh=%t\n", result.ConformanceReviewStatus, result.ConformanceReviewVerdict, result.ConformanceReviewFresh)
650: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  coverage: %d/%d changed paths\n  shards: %d/%d\n", result.CoveredPaths, result.ChangedPaths, result.CompletedShards, result.TotalShards)
651: 	for _, outcome := range []string{"confirmed", "refuted", "invalid", "inconclusive", "blocked", "cross_shard", "not_applicable"} {
652: 		if count := result.OutcomeTotals[outcome]; count > 0 {
653: 			fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  theories.%s: %d\n", outcome, count)
654: 		}
655: 	}
656: 	if result.Blocker != nil {
657: 		fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  blocker: %s (%s)\n", result.Blocker.Summary, result.Blocker.Category)
658: 	}
659: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  next: %s\n", result.NextAction)
660: }

662: func mapQACommandError(err error) error {
663: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
664: 		code := "qa.cancelled"
665: 		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
666: 			code = "qa.deadline_exceeded"
667: 		}
668: 		return classedError{class: ExitPartial, code: code, err: fmt.Errorf("sprint.qa: %w", err)}
669: 	}
670: 	if typed, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
671: 		class := ExitValidation
672: 		switch typed.Category {
673: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
674: 			class = ExitRuntime
675: 		}
676: 		return classedError{class: class, code: "qa." + string(typed.Category), err: fmt.Errorf("sprint.qa: %w", err)}
677: 	}
678: 	return mapSprintError("sprint.qa", err)
679: }

713: func qaSettings(effective config.Effective) (sprint.QASettings, error) {
714: 	c := effective.Config.QA
715: 	model := strings.TrimSpace(c.Model)
716: 	modelSource := effective.Sources["qa.model"]
717: 	if model == "" {
718: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Planning.ReviewModel)
719: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["planning.review_model"]
720: 	}
721: 	if model == "" {
722: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Planning.PlanModel)
723: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["planning.plan_model"]
724: 	}
725: 	if model == "" {
726: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Models.Default)
727: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["models.default"]
728: 	}
729: 	variant := strings.TrimSpace(c.Variant)
730: 	variantSource := effective.Sources["qa.variant"]
731: 	if variant == "" {
732: 		variant = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Execution.DefaultVariant)
733: 		variantSource = effective.Sources["execution.default_variant"]
734: 	}
735: 	parseDuration := func(field, value string) (time.Duration, error) {
736: 		duration, parseErr := time.ParseDuration(value)
737: 		if parseErr != nil {
738: 			return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", field, parseErr)
739: 		}
740: 		return duration, nil
741: 	}
742: 	commandTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.command_timeout", c.CommandTimeout)
743: 	if err != nil {
744: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
745: 	}
746: 	shardTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.shard_timeout", c.ShardTimeout)
747: 	if err != nil {
748: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
749: 	}
750: 	runTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.run_timeout", c.RunTimeout)
751: 	if err != nil {
752: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
753: 	}
754: 	cleanupTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.cleanup_timeout", c.CleanupTimeout)
755: 	if err != nil {
756: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
757: 	}
758: 	sources := make([]sprint.QAEffectiveSource, 0, len(config.QAConfigFields()))
759: 	for _, field := range config.QAConfigFields() {
760: 		source := effective.Sources[field]
761: 		if field == "qa.model" {
762: 			source = modelSource
763: 		}
764: 		if field == "qa.variant" {
765: 			source = variantSource
766: 		}
767: 		sources = append(sources, sprint.QAEffectiveSource{Field: field, Source: source})
768: 	}
769: 	sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].Field < sources[j].Field })
770: 	settings := sprint.QASettings{Runtime: sprint.StageRuntime{Model: model, Variant: variant}, Sources: sources, Budgets: sprint.QABudgets{
771: 		ChangedPaths: c.ChangedPaths, PrimaryShards: c.PrimaryShards, BoundaryShards: c.BoundaryShards,
772: 		FollowUpShards: c.FollowUpShards, TotalShards: c.TotalShards, PendingEntries: c.PendingEntries,
773: 		ChangedPathsPerShard: c.ChangedPathsPerShard, ContextPathsPerShard: c.ContextPathsPerShard,
774: 		ContextExpansions: c.ContextExpansions, PathsPerExpansion: c.PathsPerExpansion,
775: 		BehavioralConcernsPerShard: c.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, TheoriesPerShard: c.TheoriesPerShard,
776: 		IterationsPerAttempt: c.IterationsPerAttempt, CommandsPerAttempt: c.CommandsPerAttempt,
777: 		RuntimeRetries: c.RuntimeRetries, ConcurrentInvestigators: c.ConcurrentInvestigators,
778: 		CommandTimeout: commandTimeout, ShardTimeout: shardTimeout, RunTimeout: runTimeout,
779: 		CleanupTimeout: cleanupTimeout, CommandOutputBytes: c.CommandOutputBytes,
780: 		ShardOutputBytes: c.ShardOutputBytes, PromptBytes: c.PromptBytes,
781: 		RecentProgress: c.RecentProgress, RetainedAttempts: c.RetainedAttempts, StateBytes: c.StateBytes,
782: 	}}
783: 	if err := sprint.ValidateQASettings(settings); err != nil {
784: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
785: 	}
786: 	return settings, nil
787: }

825: func parseSprintSmokeArgs(args []string) (sprint.SmokeRequest, bool, error) {
826: 	var req sprint.SmokeRequest
827: 	jsonOut := false
828: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
829: 		switch args[i] {
830: 		case "--level", "--suite", "--test", "--timeout", "--override-reason":
831: 			if i+1 >= len(args) {
832: 				return req, jsonOut, fmt.Errorf("%s requires a value", args[i])
833: 			}
834: 			key, value := args[i], args[i+1]
835: 			i++
836: 			switch key {
837: 			case "--level":
838: 				req.Level = value
839: 			case "--suite":
840: 				req.Suite = value
841: 			case "--test":
842: 				req.Test = value
843: 			case "--timeout":
844: 				d, err := time.ParseDuration(value)
845: 				if err != nil || d <= 0 || d > 24*time.Hour {
846: 					return req, jsonOut, fmt.Errorf("--timeout must be positive and no more than 24h")
847: 				}
848: 				req.Timeout = d
849: 			case "--override-reason":
850: 				req.OverrideRationale = value
851: 			}
852: 		case "--force-review":
853: 			req.ForceReview = true
854: 		case "--dry-run", "--preview":
855: 			req.DryRun = true
856: 		case "--yes", "--non-interactive":
857: 			req.NonInteractive, req.OverrideConfirmed = true, true
858: 		case "--json":
859: 			jsonOut = true
860: 		default:
861: 			return req, jsonOut, fmt.Errorf("unsupported argument %q", args[i])
862: 		}
863: 	}
864: 	selected := 0
865: 	for _, value := range []string{req.Level, req.Suite, req.Test} {
866: 		if value != "" {
867: 			selected++
868: 		}
869: 	}
870: 	if selected > 1 {

944: func mapSprintError(prefix string, err error) error {
945: 	var projectRef project.RefError
946: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
947: 	switch {
948: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
949: 		return classified(ExitCancel, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
950: 	case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
951: 		return classified(ExitRuntime, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
952: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict):
953: 		return classified(ExitPartial, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
954: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported):
955: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
956: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported):
957: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
958: 	case errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef):
959: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
960: 	default:
961: 		return classified(ExitWorkspace, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
962: 	}
963: }

979: func addSprintStageOverride(overrides map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime, flag, spec string) (map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime, error) {
980: 	stageName, value, found := strings.Cut(spec, "=")
981: 	stageName = strings.TrimSpace(stageName)
982: 	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
983: 	if !found || stageName == "" || value == "" {
984: 		return overrides, fmt.Errorf("%s requires <stage>=<value> (for example %sexecute=provider/model)", flag, flag)
985: 	}
986: 	stage, ok := sprintStageOverrideTargets[stageName]
987: 	if !ok {
988: 		return overrides, fmt.Errorf("%s: unsupported stage %q", flag, stageName)
989: 	}
990: 	if overrides == nil {
991: 		overrides = map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime{}
992: 	}
993: 	override := overrides[stage]
994: 	if flag == "--stage-model" {
995: 		override.Model = value
996: 	} else {
997: 		override.Variant = value
998: 	}
999: 	overrides[stage] = override
1000: 	return overrides, nil
1001: }

1003: func parseSprintFlowArgs(args []string) (sprint.FlowRequest, error) {
1004: 	req := sprint.FlowRequest{}
1005: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
1006: 		if flag, value, found := strings.Cut(args[i], "="); found && (flag == "--stage-model" || flag == "--stage-variant") {
1007: 			if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
1008: 				return req, fmt.Errorf("%s requires <stage>=<value>", flag)
1009: 			}
1010: 			var err error
1011: 			req.StageOverrides, err = addSprintStageOverride(req.StageOverrides, flag, value)
1012: 			if err != nil {
1013: 				return req, err
1014: 			}
1015: 			continue
1016: 		}
1017: 		switch args[i] {
1018: 		case "--to":
1019: 			if i+1 >= len(args) {
1020: 				return req, fmt.Errorf("--to requires a stage")
1021: 			}
1022: 			req.To = sprint.PlanningStage(args[i+1])
1023: 			i++
1024: 		case "--dry-run":
1025: 			req.DryRun = true
1026: 		case "--model":
1027: 			if i+1 >= len(args) {
1028: 				return req, fmt.Errorf("--model requires a provider/model value")
1029: 			}
1030: 			i++
1031: 			req.ModelOverride = args[i]
1032: 		case "--variant":
1033: 			if i+1 >= len(args) {
1034: 				return req, fmt.Errorf("--variant requires a value")
1035: 			}
1036: 			i++
1037: 			req.VariantOverride = args[i]
1038: 		case "--stage-model", "--stage-variant":
1039: 			if i+1 >= len(args) {
1040: 				return req, fmt.Errorf("%s requires <stage>=<value>", args[i])
1041: 			}
1042: 			i++
1043: 			var err error
1044: 			req.StageOverrides, err = addSprintStageOverride(req.StageOverrides, args[i-1], args[i])
1045: 			if err != nil {
1046: 				return req, err
1047: 			}
1048: 		case "--restart-review":
1049: 			req.Review.Restart = true
1050: 		case "--yes", "--non-interactive":
1051: 			req.Smoke.NonInteractive, req.Smoke.OverrideConfirmed = true, true
1052: 		case "--force-review":
1053: 			req.Smoke.ForceReview = true
1054: 		case "--override-reason":
1055: 			if i+1 >= len(args) {
1056: 				return req, fmt.Errorf("--override-reason requires a value")
1057: 			}
1058: 			i++
1059: 			req.Smoke.OverrideRationale = args[i]
1060: 		default:
1061: 			return req, fmt.Errorf("unsupported argument %q", args[i])
1062: 		}
1063: 	}
1064: 	if req.To == "" {
1065: 		return req, fmt.Errorf("--to requirements, --to code-context, --to sprint-index, --to technical-handbook, --to area-reasoning, --to reasoning, --to plan, --to execute, --to review, or --to smoke is required")
1066: 	}
1067: 	if req.To != sprint.StageRequirements && req.To != sprint.StageCodeContext && req.To != sprint.StageSprintIndex && req.To != sprint.StageTechnicalHandbook && req.To != sprint.StageAreaReasoning && req.To != sprint.StageReasoning && req.To != sprint.StagePlan && req.To != sprint.StageExecute && req.To != sprint.StageReview && req.To != sprint.StageSmoke {
1068: 		return req, fmt.Errorf("unsupported flow target %q", req.To)
1069: 	}
1070: 	if req.Smoke.ForceReview && strings.TrimSpace(req.Smoke.OverrideRationale) == "" {
1071: 		return req, fmt.Errorf("--force-review requires --override-reason")
1072: 	}
1073: 	return req, nil
1074: }

228: 	for {
229: 		select {
230: 		case <-ctx.Done():
231: 			return
232: 		case <-owned.stop:
233: 			return

238: 				return

242: 					owned.cancel()
243: 					return
244: 				}

246: 				return

249: 				if _, err := m.repository.Heartbeat(ctx, owned.fence, runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration); err != nil {
250: 					owned.cancel()

257: 					owned.cancel()
258: 					return
259: 				}

269: 	delete(m.owned, runID)
270: 	m.mu.Unlock()
271: 	if owned == nil {
272: 		return nil
273: 	}

276: 		_, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{Type: runcontrol.EventOmission, Omission: &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced", Count: owned.omitted, FirstAt: &owned.omittedFirst, LastAt: &owned.omittedLast}})
277: 		if appendErr != nil && runErr == nil {
278: 			runErr = appendErr
279: 		}
280: 		owned.omitted = 0
281: 	}

283: 	close(owned.stop)
284: 	<-owned.done
285: 	owned.cancel()
286: 	outcome := runcontrol.TerminalSucceeded
287: 	reason := "operation completed"
288: 	switch {
289: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded):
290: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalTimedOut, "operation deadline exceeded"
291: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), state == OperationCancelled:
292: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalCancelled, "operation cancelled"
293: 	case runErr != nil, state == OperationFailed:

295: 	case state == OperationPartial:
296: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalInterrupted, "operation interrupted"

Observations in run_commands.go:

**runDiagnostics JSON status**: `writeJSON(deps.stdout, "run diagnostics", root, string(health.Status), ...)` — the `status` field of the shared envelope is normally "ok". Here it's the health status string. What values can health.Status take? If health is degraded, does runDiagnostics still exit 0? Yes — no error returned. So a script doing `ultraplan run diagnostics --json` gets exit 0 but `status: "degraded"` (or whatever). Is that documented? Let me check cli-reference.md for the diagnostics envelope. Also, what are possible HealthStatus values — need to check runcontrol. This may be intentional ("status reflects repository health"). Check docs.

**orderRunArgs**: For `--reason` valued flag with `=` form: `--reason=custom` → name="--reason", contains "=", so not consumed as separate token. Good. But subtle bug: for valued flags where value itself starts with "--": e.g. `run cancel <id> --reason --json`. orderRunArgs: arg "--reason" isFlag=true, valued && !contains(=) → i++ consumes "--json" as the reason VALUE. Then fs.Parse sees ["--reason","--json"]... wait no, flags=["--reason","--json"], positionals=["<id>"] → parsed args: --reason takes "--json" as its value. Then canonicalCancellationReason("--json") fails → usage exit 2. Acceptable-ish (weird input anyway).

But here's a real edge: `run show -- --json`? flag package treats "--" as terminator; orderRunArgs would move "--json" before "--"... eh.

More interesting **orderRunArgs positional misclassification**: any unrecognized flag-looking token goes to positionals. E.g., `run follow <id> --verbose` → positionals=["<id>","--verbose"], NArg()=2 → usage error. Fine.

What about `run list --limit=abc`: fs.Parse errors → usage. Fine.

**runList**: `fs.Parse(args)` without ordering; flags must precede positionals — but list has no positionals allowed (NArg()!=0 → error). OK.

**runCancel changed=false**: When cancellation already requested (idempotent?), RequestCancellation returns changed=false and snapshot; exit 0. Fine.

Now — **mapRunControlError ErrNotFound→5**: `classifiedCause(ExitValidation, err, operation)` — note argument order! Look at signature: `classifiedCause(class int, cause error, format string, args ...any)`. It formats `format+": %w"` appending cause LAST: `fmt.Errorf(format+": %w", append(args, cause)...)`. In mapRunControlError: `classifiedCause(ExitUsage, err, operation)` → format = operation string, cause=err appended as arg → message "run.show: <err>". Good.

But in `beginDurableCLICommand`: `classifiedCause(ExitRuntime, err, "run-control.accept")` → "run-control.accept: <err>". Good.

In `Finish`: `classifiedCause(ExitRuntime, err, "run-control.finish")`. Good.

mapSmokeError: `classifiedCause(ExitCancel, se, "%s", se.Code)` → format "%s" with args [se.Code, se]?? Wait: `append(args, cause)` where args=[se.Code] → fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", se.Code, se) → "<code>: <err>". OK good.

Hmm wait, there's a subtle bug possibility in classifiedCause when format contains no verbs and args non-empty... not our case.

**runFollow exit 0 on ctx done** — documented observation-only. OK.

**runFollow JSON encoder.Encode(event)** — NDJSON. On broken pipe returns raw err → fail prints + ExitError(1). Fine.

Now durable_operations.go observations:

**AcceptOperation alias dedup dead branch**: digest="" always from CLI (`beginDurableCLICommand` passes ""). With digest=="", the `errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrConflict)` branch is skipped (condition requires digest != ""), so conflict → wrapped error "persist confirmed operation acceptance: ..." → ExitRuntime. Hmm wait — what does repository.Accept return if an identical operation is already running (e.g., two concurrent `sprint flow` invocations)? If it returns ErrConflict, CLI exits 6 runtime instead of a clearer code. That's the durable-operation-spine's domain though.

**Finish state classification**: `state := OperationComplete; if c.accepted.Context.Err() != nil { state = OperationCancelled }`. Note accepted.Context is the operationCtx which is cancelled by controlOperation goroutine on heartbeat failure etc. If heartbeat fails mid-run (transient DB lock), controlOperation cancels ctx → Finish classifies OperationCancelled even though runErr might be a real failure. Minor.

**finishDurableCLICommand joins finish error into runErr**: `errors.Join(runErr, command.Finish(runErr))`. Then callers do `strings.Contains(err.Error(), "runtime")` on joined message. Join inserts "\n" between messages. Multi-line error printed via fail() → multi-line stderr. Also: if runErr==nil but finish fails, flow/verify/execute/review/smoke treat err != nil → exit 6 with "run-control.finish: ...". Documented unknown #5. The command DID complete successfully but exits 6 — misleading failure for scripts (they'd rerun a completed op). Severity moderate but it's cross-surface (durable spine owns FinishOperation); the dispatch surface owns joining. The pack lists it as unknown #5. Docs don't address it. Hmm — "misleading success" reversed: misleading failure. It's a deliberate design (surface terminal persistence failure). I'll note as defended/non-issue unless docs contradict.

Wait, actually there's something sharper in flow: line 248-256:

```go
result, err = runSprintFlow(runCtx, flowService, args[0], args[1], req)
err = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
if result.DryRun && err == nil {
```

For NON-dry-run success: falls through to line 257 `if err != nil` false → line 274 jsonOut etc. Fine.

For dry-run: durable==nil → finishDurableCLICommand(nil, err) returns err unchanged. result.DryRun==true. Fine.

BUT what about non-dry-run flow where Flow returns result with DryRun field true? Probably impossible.

**Execute defer path**: `req.DeferReason != ""` skips durable wrap entirely — pack says documented. But then `err = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)` with durable=nil → fine.

Wait — execute: `if !req.DryRun && req.DeferReason == ""` begins durable. Defer runs outside durable boundary. OK per pack.

**QA run/resume: after RunQA fails, QAStatus is still queried; if QAStatus succeeds, qaResult set; runErr stays qaErr.** Then envelope written with status failed + error payload. Exit via mapQACommandError. Note `stableQACommandError(mapQACommandError(runErr), runErr, qaResult)`. OK.

429: func runtimeProgressSummary(event runtimepkg.Event) string {
430: 	parts := []string{}
431: 	if event.Type != "" {
432: 		parts = append(parts, event.Type)
433: 	} else if event.Kind != "" {
434: 		parts = append(parts, event.Kind)
435: 	}
436: 	for _, key := range []string{"state", "phase", "status", "tool", "name", "attempt", "provider", "model", "retry_after", "delay", "reason", "detail", "error"} {
437: 		value, ok := event.Payload[key]
438: 		if !ok {
439: 			continue
440: 		}
441: 		text := strings.TrimSpace(fmt.Sprint(value))
442: 		if text == "" || text == "<nil>" {
443: 			continue
444: 		}
445: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", key, config.RedactValue("runtime."+key, text)))
446: 	}
447: 	if len(parts) == 0 {
448: 		return "event"
449: 	}
450: 	return strings.Join(parts, " ")
451: }

457: 			return config.RedactValue("runtime."+key, text)

459: 	}
460: 	return ""

579: func parseRunAllArgs(args []string) (runAllFlags, error) {
580: 	var flags runAllFlags
581: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
582: 		arg := args[i]
583: 		next := func(name string) (string, error) {
584: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
585: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s requires a value", name)
586: 			}
587: 			i++
588: 			return args[i], nil
589: 		}
590: 		switch {
591: 		case arg == "--dimension":
592: 			value, err := next(arg)
593: 			if err != nil {
594: 				return flags, err
595: 			}
596: 			flags.dimensions = append(flags.dimensions, value)
597: 		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dimension="):
598: 			flags.dimensions = append(flags.dimensions, strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--dimension="))
599: 		case arg == "--source":
600: 			value, err := next(arg)
601: 			if err != nil {
602: 				return flags, err
603: 			}
604: 			flags.sources = append(flags.sources, value)
605: 		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--source="):
606: 			flags.sources = append(flags.sources, strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--source="))
607: 		case arg == "--model":
608: 			value, err := next(arg)
609: 			if err != nil {
610: 				return flags, err
611: 			}
612: 			if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
613: 				return flags, fmt.Errorf("--model requires a provider/model value")
614: 			}
615: 			flags.model = value
616: 		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--model="):
617: 			flags.model = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--model=")
618: 			if strings.TrimSpace(flags.model) == "" {
619: 				return flags, fmt.Errorf("--model requires a provider/model value")
620: 			}
621: 		case arg == "--parallel":
622: 			value, err := next(arg)
623: 			if err != nil {
624: 				return flags, err
625: 			}
626: 			n, err := parsePositiveIntFlag("--parallel", value)
627: 			if err != nil {
628: 				return flags, err
629: 			}
630: 			flags.parallelism = &n
631: 		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--parallel="):
632: 			n, err := parsePositiveIntFlag("--parallel", strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--parallel="))
633: 			if err != nil {
634: 				return flags, err
635: 			}
636: 			flags.parallelism = &n
637: 		default:
638: 			return flags, fmt.Errorf("unknown argument %q", arg)
639: 		}
640: 	}
641: 	return flags, nil
642: }

The run-loop persists studies/<study>/.ultraplan/run-state.json after each meaningful task transition, appends execution history to studies/<study>/.ultraplan/runs/tasks.jsonl, refreshes studies/<study>/.ultraplan/runs/summary.md, cancels through the runtime boundary on interrupt, and refuses concurrent invocations unless --force-unlock is used.

664: func parsePositiveIntFlag(name, value string) (int, error) {
665: 	n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
666: 	if err != nil {
667: 		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s must be an integer", name)
668: 	}
669: 	if n < 1 {
670: 		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s must be at least 1", name)
671: 	}
672: 	return n, nil
673: }

675: func runAllService(deps dependencies, root workspace.Root, flags runAllFlags) (study.Service, int, error) {
676: 	effective, err := loadEffectiveConfig(root, deps, config.CLIOverrides{})
677: 	if err != nil {
678: 		return study.Service{}, 0, err
679: 	}
680: 	parallelism := effective.Config.Execution.DefaultParallel
681: 	if flags.parallelism != nil {
682: 		parallelism = *flags.parallelism
683: 	}
684: 	if parallelism < 1 {
685: 		return study.Service{}, 0, classified(ExitConfig, "study run-all: parallelism must be at least 1")
686: 	}
687: 	req, err := runtimepkg.RequestFromConfig(effective.Config, root.Path)
688: 	if err != nil {
689: 		return study.Service{}, 0, classified(ExitConfig, "runtime.config: %w", err)
690: 	}
691: 	rt, err := studyRuntimeFactory(effective.Config)
692: 	if err != nil {
693: 		return study.Service{}, 0, classified(ExitRuntime, "runtime.init: %w", err)

695: 	controlled, err := controlledRuntimeFor(deps, root.Path, effective.Config, rt)
696: 	if err != nil {
697: 		return study.Service{}, 0, classified(ExitRuntime, "run-control.init: %w", err)
698: 	}
699: 	return study.NewService(root.Path, study.WithRuntime(controlled, req), study.WithPublisher(stagePublisher(effective.Config))), parallelism, nil

933: func classifyExecutionResult(prefix string, result study.ExecutionResult) error {

937: 	case study.ExecutionStatusRuntimeFailed:

939: 	case study.ExecutionStatusCancelled:
940: 		return classedError{class: ExitCancel, code: errorCode(ExitCancel), err: fmt.Errorf("%s: cancelled", prefix)}
941: 	case study.ExecutionStatusValidationFailed:

961: func parseStudyModelArgs(args []string) ([]string, string, error) {
962: 	var positional []string
963: 	model := ""

966: 		switch {

968: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
969: 				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("--model requires a provider/model value")
970: 			}
971: 			i++
972: 			if strings.TrimSpace(args[i]) == "" {
973: 				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("--model requires a provider/model value")
974: 			}
975: 			model = args[i]

981: 		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-"):
982: 			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("unknown argument %q", arg)
983: 		default:
984: 			positional = append(positional, arg)

433: 	} else if event.Kind != "" {
434: 		parts = append(parts, event.Kind)
435: 	}
436: 	for _, key := range []string{"state", "phase", "status", "tool", "name", "attempt", "provider", "model", "retry_after", "delay", "reason", "detail", "error"} {
437: 		value, ok := event.Payload[key]
438: 		if !ok {
439: 			continue
440: 		}
441: 		text := strings.TrimSpace(fmt.Sprint(value))
442: 		if text == "" || text == "<nil>" {
443: 			continue
444: 		}
445: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", key, config.RedactValue("runtime."+key, text)))
446: 	}
447: 	if len(parts) == 0 {
448: 		return "event"
449: 	}
450: 	return strings.Join(parts, " ")
